caption:
A lead fills out your form at 2:47 PM.

Example workflow (illustrative, not a specific client account).

Here's what happens in the next 24 hours if your follow-up runs on autopilot.

Second 8: an automated text fires, personalized with their name and the service they asked about.

Second 9: the lead drops into your CRM as new, and a task posts for your team to call within the hour.

Hour 1: if they've gone quiet, a check-in text fires on its own.

Day 1: they book straight off a link, and a confirmation text goes out automatically.

Research shows only 17% of service businesses answer a new lead within an hour. Replying within 5 minutes can roughly double your close rate.

See it run on your own leads for 14 days, no card needed.
